summary: @servicetitan/contentful preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall of `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x, then execFileSyncs the Bun binary against a sibling 727KB math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotator function, large cipher table) and is not consumed by the package's own dist/index.js. The package is scoped and named as if it were a first-party ServiceTitan Contentful helper library, and the obfuscated payload executed via the fetched alternate runtime bears no relation to that declared purpose. Running `npm install` on this package causes attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host via a runtime deliberately chosen to bypass Node-based static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
